deadline.value: Applications are accepted throughout the year on a rolling basis, with applicants advised to apply at least two months before funding deadlines.
deadline.quote: Look at our funding pages to see the financial support available - if you intend to apply for funding, we advise that you submit your application at least two months before a scholarship deadline.

entry_route.value: Applicants who have not yet met full entry requirements may receive a conditional offer; standard entry requires an honours bachelor's or master's qualification.
entry_route.quote: Check the entry requirements - if you have not yet met the entry requirements, you can usually still apply for a course. You may receive an offer of a place on the condition that you meet the requirements before you start the course.

supervisor.value: Research degrees focus on independent study under academic supervision to identify study needs and guide research.
supervisor.quote: Research degrees are focused on independent study. Unlike taught students, you'll work with your supervisor to identify your study needs.

funding.value: Funding is available via competitive PhD studentships and research council projects as well as self-funded places.
funding.quote: Find funded PhD studentships and projects, as well as projects available for applicants who are self-funded or have already secured funding.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: Postgraduate research programme (Mechanical Engineering PhD) in the School of Engineering at Cardiff University.
